desc: 手持锂电一机切磨多料，暗场火花与亮场结构双线取证
leaf: 手持式锂电多功能切割机（锯铝型材／切钢管／打磨除锈多用，配薄型齿段切割片）
name: 手持锂电多功能精密切割机款

shots.intent: 用暗场与一记真实的切割火花抢第一眼点击，把重负荷切割的主张在没有任何参数的前提下讲完。
shots.textZone: 上三分之一干净留白带：主标题位 「{selling_point_1}」 in #FFFFFF at 44pt，其下一枚 #C4161C 底圆角条 「{callout_1}」 in #FFFFFF at 16pt

shots.intent: 在纯亮场正对镜头交出整机轮廓，把源图四宫格用途收成一句主张，承接首屏点击后的第二秒。
shots.textZone: 上部干净留白带：主标题位 「{selling_point_2}」 in #2D2D2D at 36pt，其下一枚 #C4161C 底圆角条 「{callout_1}」 in #FFFFFF at 14pt 与三枚小圆点分隔符

shots.intent: 同构图同裁切只改作业条件，把斜切毛刺、拼缝不齐与昏暗工位三重现场损耗具象化后再交解法。
同一块铝型材斜切对接的切前切后同框同光，用肉眼可辨的拼缝差替代一切精度形容词。
shots.textZone: 每条右侧一枚标签位 「{callout_1}」 in #2D2D2D at 16pt 与 「{callout_2}」 in #C4161C at 16pt

shots.intent: 侧面实景把机器放进门窗与型材加工的第一现场，让金属加工买家直接代入自己的工位。
高俯角把铝型材、钢管、锈板与木料四块待切面平铺同框，用可见的材种覆盖替代一机多用的口头主张。
贴到齿段、片芯与法兰压圈上，用可数的齿形与真实厚度质感替代精度与耐用的口头承诺。
把散热窗、主轴锁与握把包覆三个可核验部位单列编号引线，讲清过载与单手换片的作业机制而不写任何参数。
shots.textZone: 右侧三枚编号圆点条 「{callout_1}」「{callout_2}」「{callout_3}」 in #C4161C at 14pt，各接一根发丝引线指向对应部位

shots.intent: 把源图细节屏仅有的两处作业设计单独放大成双视窗，讲清照明与开关逻辑，坚决不写灯珠数量与认证。
shots.textZone: 两枚视窗左侧各一条编号短标签位 「{callout_1}」「{callout_2}」 in #2D2D2D at 16pt，各接一根发丝引线

shots.intent: 以法兰压圈、机壳合模线与握底电池卡脚三个可核验视窗建立信任，坚决不碰资质、检测与会员背书。
shots.textZone: 三枚视窗下方各一条短标签位 「{callout_1}」「{callout_2}」「{callout_3}」 in #2D2D2D at 14pt

shots.intent: 把切、磨、除锈三档理由收成编号条并给出唯一动作，让详情页在结尾不留悬念，同时把源图会员码位彻底剔除。
shots.textZone: 每栏左侧一行短句位 「{callout_1}」「{callout_2}」「{callout_3}」 in #FFFFFF at 18pt，底部一枚 #FFFFFF 底圆角按钮位 「{callout_4}」 in #2D2D2D at 20pt

style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: one consistent premium handheld cordless power-tool ecommerce visual system across the whole set; fixed palette of primary field #FFFFFF, secondary card field #F1F2F4, headline text #2D2D2D, one accent #C4161C, one dark field #141416 and one spark tone #F2601A; neutral temperature held across every screen with the spark burn confined to the opening hero; one font family, modern geometric sans-serif, with a heavy condensed weight for Chinese set in 「」; background system of a single matte #141416 hero field, seamless matte #FFFFFF studio panels, matte #F1F2F4 card fields, one #C4161C accent field on the proof and closing screens only, and real work surfaces only on the scene screens, with no scenery and no gradient wash; raking side key light from frame-left at 5600K that renders moulded housing, machined spindle collar, segment teeth and casing seams with visible grain, plus one slim rim light and a firm contact shadow under the grip base; minimal infographic language only, namely rounded chips on #C4161C with #FFFFFF type, oversized low-contrast numerals, hairline dividers, hairline leader lines and one short underline bar; the product is always the same single handheld cutting tool at stable scale with pistol-grip housing, battery block under the grip and the thin flat bare segment-toothed disc in the same relative positions, never fitted with a guard, base plate or fence the reference does not show, level horizon and straight verticals kept straight; no palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched chip styles, no invented specification numbers, no hands or operators, no certificates, no QR codes, no membership or store marks.

no hands, fingers, gloves, operators or safety-gear wearers anywhere in the set, and nothing ever touching the bare disc
